questions.q: What URL do you use to reach the Azure AI Foundry portal?
questions.explain: Azure AI Foundry (now officially Microsoft Foundry) is reached at ai.azure.com, a separate portal from the general Azure portal.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the four main areas of the Foundry portal?
questions.explain: The four main areas are the model catalog, playgrounds, build and customize tools, and assess and improve tools. Billing calculators and VM/DNS management belong to the general Azure portal, not Foundry.

questions.q: What can you do in the chat playground without writing any SDK code?
options: Nothing — code is required for any testing
Set a system message, pick a deployment, and send test prompts
questions.explain: The chat playground lets you pick a deployed model, write a system message, and test prompts directly in the browser before you write any code.

questions.q: What does the Metrics menu in the agents playground let you do?
options: Change your Azure subscription billing tier
Turn on quick evaluation checks like task adherence and coherence without leaving the page
questions.explain: The Metrics menu in the agents playground lets you select quick evaluation metrics — task adherence, coherence, hate and unfairness, and more — to check agent quality interactively.

questions.q: What is the current (2026) official brand name for what this course calls Azure AI Foundry?
questions.explain: Microsoft renamed Azure AI Studio to Azure AI Foundry, and as of 2026 the current official name is Microsoft Foundry — though the portal URL and most existing documentation still say Azure AI Foundry.
